affiliation: Anna Lindh Professor of the Practice of Global Leadership and Public Policy, HKS; William D. Zabel '61 Professor of Practice in Human Rights, HLS
bio: Samantha Power is the Anna Lindh Professor of the Practice of Global Leadership and Public Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School and the William D. Zabel ’61 Professor of Practice in Human Rights at the Harvard Law School. She was a Professor of Practice at both schools from 2017 to 2021.
